Class ListOptions

java.lang.Object
org.apache.opendal.ListOptions
public class ListOptions extends Object
Options for list operations.

Options that require an unsupported service capability fail with OpenDALException.Code.Unsupported. When globbing is supported, invalid glob patterns fail with OpenDALException.Code.ConfigInvalid. limit is a pagination hint that services may ignore even when Capability.listWithLimit is supported.

Optional reference fields default to null.

    • recursive

      public final boolean recursive

    • limit

      public final long limit
      Maximum results per request (backend hint) to control memory and throttling.

      Services may ignore this pagination hint even when Capability.listWithLimit is supported. The default of -1L leaves the limit unset. Positive values must fit the native platform's unsigned pointer-sized integer. 0L, other negative values, and values that do not fit fail with OpenDALException.Code.Unexpected.

    • glob

      public final String glob
      Filter entries with a case-sensitive Unix shell style glob pattern.

      The pattern is relative to the listed directory, or to the parent directory when the list path is a prefix without a trailing slash. Entries must also satisfy the list prefix. The pattern determines which depths can match, independently of recursive.

      Requires Capability.listWithGlob. OpenDAL simulates glob matching client-side when the service lacks native support. A simulated pattern spanning multiple directories also requires Capability.listWithRecursive when combined with startAfter, versions, or deleted. Missing required capabilities fail with OpenDALException.Code.Unsupported. When globbing is supported, empty or malformed patterns fail with OpenDALException.Code.ConfigInvalid.

      See Also:
      • Capability.listWithGlob
